name: settleflow
description: Production-ready order and settlement tracking application

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @settleflow/shared build && pnpm --filter @settleflow/web build && pnpm --filter @settleflow/api build
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web,worker --prefix-colors magenta,blue,green "pnpm --filter @settleflow/api dev" "pnpm --filter @settleflow/web dev" "pnpm --filter @settleflow/api dev:worker"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @settleflow/shared test && pnpm --filter @settleflow/api test && pnpm --filter @settleflow/web test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @settleflow/shared build && pnpm --filter @settleflow/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @settleflow/web typecheck && pnpm exec tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit
